entries.summary: Michael R. Bloomberg, chairman of the trustees, hosted the Serpentine Summer Party on 23 June 2026 with the gallery's chief executive and artistic director.
entries.evidence: The evening was hosted by Michael R. Bloomberg, Chairman of Serpentine’s Board of Trustees

entries.summary: Mark Getty received an honorary knighthood in January 2016 for services to the arts and philanthropy. The gallery's release said the award recognised in particular his leadership of and support for the National Gallery.
entries.evidence: in particular his leadership of and support for the National Gallery over many years

entries.summary: Mark Getty was a trustee from September 1999 and chaired the Board of Trustees from August 2009 to August 2015.
entries.evidence: Trustee from September 1999 until August 2009, when he was elected Chair

entries.summary: The gallery commissioned a bronze bust of Sir Paul Getty from Gerald Laing in 1996 to acknowledge his £50 million donation. It stands in the Main Vestibule.
entries.evidence: This bust was commissioned by the National Gallery to acknowledge Paul Getty’s £50 million donation

entries.summary: Thomas Girst, head of cultural communication at BMW Group, told taz in March 2012, in an interview on the BMW Guggenheim Lab: "Natürlich geht es auch um Reputation" (reputation is of course also a reason).
entries.evidence: dass unser Kulturengagement aus altruistischen Gründen geschieht. Natürlich geht es auch um Reputation.

entries.summary: Fridays for Future Salzburg staged a die-in at the first Jedermann performance in July 2022 with a banner reading "Audi: Vorsprung durch Greenwashing", objecting to Audi as festival sponsor.
entries.evidence: Dazu ein Banner mit der Aufschrift „Audi: Vorsprung durch Greenwashing“. Kritisiert wird Audi als Sponsor

entries.summary: Fridays for Future Salzburg protested at the Cosi fan tutte premiere in August 2020, naming Audi among sponsors and saying the festival offers such industries "a platform to improve their image".
entries.evidence: bieten diesen eine Plattform zur Verbesserung ihres Images

entries.summary: Chung Euisun, executive chair of Hyundai Motor Group, received an honorary CBE in November 2023 for contributions to the arts, culture and eco-friendly mobility. The Korea Times report cited Hyundai's long sponsorship of Tate Modern.
entries.evidence: Chung won the honor for his contributions to the arts, culture and eco-friendly mobility

entries.summary: Penny Pritzker chaired the museum's board from 1996 to 1999 and is a life member of the Board of Trustees.
entries.evidence: Life Member of the Board of Trustees. Served as Board Chair from 1996 to 1999.

entries.summary: Telefónica held its centenary gala at the Teatro Real on 19 April 2024, with King Felipe VI presiding and more than 1,100 guests.
entries.evidence: the Centenary Gala at the Teatro Real in Madrid and presided over by His Majesty

entries.summary: Salvador García Ruiz, director of corporate affairs and sustainability at Telefónica, sits on the theatre's Board of Protectors, the body of sponsor company representatives.
entries.evidence: Salvador García Ruiz Director of Corporate Affairs and Sustainability at Telefónica, S.A.

entries.summary: Telefónica opened its centenary year with a Lang Lang concert at the Liceu on 26 February 2024 for more than 1,200 guests, among them a minister and the mayor of Barcelona.
